Name: Em's Horse Fellowship (Lord of the Rings collection)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Seven (7) horses based on the Lord of the Rings fellowship characters. (some movie and some book-based)
Available for CP and AT, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]

The different horses are:
Brego, horse of Aragorn
Asfaloth, horse of Arwin
Arod, horse of Legolas
Bill the Pony, hobbit's supply
Shadowfax, ﻿Lord of the Mearas, ridden by Gandalf
Snowmane, horse of ﻿Théoden
Warg rider, ridden by orcs

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Horse Fellowship CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default is the Brego. To choose a different type:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the horse mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Brego[/color]" with the name of the type you like
There is a [i]reference.png[/i] with all the options in the folder
Alternatively, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/k5MPXyZH/Lotr-Armour.png[/img]

Each horse can be ridden with or without its armour
Replace "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" to dis/enable the tack
The tack options are named after the horses, eg, ArodArmour

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Horse Fellowship AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the horse and choose its type
You can pick each horse with or without armour

Note: if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url], change the left-click key first. Horse Overhaul uses left-click to open the saddlebag. AT uses it to access the texture menu. If you change the opening of the saddlebags to another key, you can access the texture menu with the scissors.
